        <section class="nike-policy-section body-large">
            <article class="nike-policy-content">
                <h2 class="title-medium">CONSUMER CARE STORE CLAIM AND EXCHANGE POLICY</h2>
                <article class="nike-claim">
                    <h3 class="title-small">CLAIMS</h3>
                    <p>
                        If you think your product has a manufacturing defect, you can
                        <a href="https://www.nike.com/in/help/claims/terms" target="_blank">submit a product claim</a> for purchases made at Nike stores and
                        authorised Nike retail stores with the following photographs:
                    </p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>A picture of your product and the area you believe to have a manufacturing defect.</li>
                        <li>The store receipt or invoice clearly showing the purchase date, purchase location, and purchase amount.</li>
                        <li>The product tag on your footwear or apparel (please ensure the product number is clearly visible). For equipment claims, be sure to include a picture of the attached sticker.
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                    <p>
                        After a claim is submitted, Nike will then inspect the claim to determine if the condition of the claim product is due to a manufacturing defect or not. Nike’s decision in respect of the claim product shall be final and confidential. If Nike is unable to process the claim on the basis of the information or photographs sent, the same will be communicated to the store and consumer through the same claim thread.
                    </p>
                    <p>
                        Upon receipt of the authorisation email from Nike for replacement of a product, the consumer should present a hard or soft copy of the email to the original place of purchase. The authorised partner will then allow the consumer to choose a product of the same or lesser purchase value of the original purchase as available at that time in the store.
                    </p>
                    <p>
                        In case of unavailability of the same or similar product there shall be no cash refund, but the consumer will be entitled to choose any other Nike product from the available stock that's equal to or lower than the actual price paid. If the replacement value is lower, the differential amount shall not be refunded. If the replacement value is higher than the purchase value, the consumer shall have to pay the differential of the amount.
                    </p>
                    <p>
                        Stores, retailers, and consumers must ensure that the replacement process is completed within 30 calendar days from the date of the authorisation email sent by Nike. After 30 calendar days, the consumer will not be eligible for a replacement from Nike.
                    </p>
                </article>
                <article class="claim-elegibility">
                    <h3 class="title-small">CLAIM ELIGIBILITY</h3>
                    <p>
                        Claims past six months from the original purchase date will not be accepted. Claims will also be rejected in the following situations:
                    </p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Any counterfeit or non-genuine Nike products.</li>
                        <li>Any product missing its manufacturing tag or product sticker.</li>
                        <li>Any item deemed to be free of a manufacturing defect or flaw.</li>
                        <li>Any products that exhibit excessive wear, misuse, alteration, or wear and tear deemed to be normal.</li>
                        <li>Any products subjected to harsh treatment, such as contact with any sharp, rough, abrasive, or acidic materials that may cause damage, intentional or not.</li>
                        <li>Any product deemed by Nike to have been damaged by misuse.</li>
                        <li>Any product purchased from online or store retailers that are not authorised by Nike.</li>
                    </ul>
                </article>
                <article class="exchange-elegibility">
                    <h3 class="title-small">EXCHANGE ELIGIBILITY</h3>
                    <p>
                        Products can only be exchanged due to size, fit, or style at the original place of purchase. Nike-authorised retail partners have their own respective return and exchange policies, hence please refer to your invoice or the store’s terms and conditions.
                    </p>
                </article>
                <article class="definitions-elegibility">
                    <h3 class="title-small">DEFINITIONS AND ELIGIBILITY</h3>
                    <h4 class="title-xsmall">Business Days</h4>
                    <p>Business days shall mean English calendar days.</p>
                    <h4 class="title-xsmall">Consumer</h4>
                    <p>
                        A consumer shall mean and include any person, or individual, who has purchased a product from any Nike store or Nike-authorised retail partner.
                    </p>
                    <h4 class="title-xsmall">Claim Procedure</h4>
                    <p>
                        The procedure, as outlined herein, to be followed by the consumer to claim a replacement of a Nike product.
                    </p>
                    <h4 class="title-xsmall">Discount</h4>
                    <p>
                        Sale of products at a discount which shall be offered to a consumer at a Nike factory store or Nike authorised store, physical and online.
                    </p>
                    <h4 class="title-xsmall">Manufacturing Defects</h4>
                    <p>
                        Any and all defects in production pertaining to materials or workmanship. Such defects include issues related to bonding, stitching, material or components failure, cosmetics, and workmanship. This guarantee applies when the product is used under normal conditions and for the purpose for which the product was designed. This does not apply to normal wear and tear or damage related to alteration, accident, misuse, improper care, or negligence.
                    </p>
                    <h4 class="title-xsmall">Maximum Retail Price (MRP), Normal Conditions</h4>
                    <p>
                        MRP shall mean the maximum retail price at which a Nike product is sold which shall not include the discount offered, if any, on the products.
                    </p>
                    <h4 class="title-xsmall">Products</h4>
                    <p>
                        The Nike products shall be broadly categorized into footwear, apparel, equipment, and any other category which shall stand included into the existing categories by Nike upon introduction of such line of products in the Indian retail market.
                    </p>
                    <h4 class="title-xsmall">Store</h4>
                    <p>
                        Stores authorised by Nike can be classified into the following three categories listed below in this policy, which shall include the mono-brand store, multi-brand store, and the factory outlet store.
                    </p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>
                            <h4 class="title-xsmall">Mono-brand Store</h4>
                            <p>
                                Stores exclusively selling Nike-branded products are referred to as the mono-brand stores, and the business shall be conducted by different retail partners across the country appointed by Nike as authorised partners.
                            </p>
                        </li>
                        <li>
                            <h4 class="title-xsmall">Multi-brand Store</h4>
                            <p>
                                The stores that cater to multiple brands and shall also be selling Nike products within their stores alongside other branded products.
                            </p>
                            <ul>
                                <li>Footlocker</li>
                                <li>Veg Non Veg</li>
                                <li>Superkicks</li>
                                <li>Limited Edt</li>
                                <li>Kick Sports</li>
                                <li>Metro Activ</li>
                                <li>Shoppers Stop</li>
                                <li>Sports Yard</li>
                                <li>V-Retail</li>
                            </ul>
                        </li>
                        <li>
                            <h4 class="title-xsmall">Online store purchase</h4>
                            <p>
                                Online store purchase shall mean and include a purchase made by a consumer from Nike or Nike authorised online retailer in India that sells Nike product. Authorised online retailers include:
                            </p>
                            <ul>

                                <li>Amazon (<a href="https://www.amazon.in/">www.amazon.in</a>), through its authorized seller, Westbury</li>
                                <li>Tata Cliq (<a href="https://www.tatacliq.com/">www.tatacliq.com</a>) & <strong>Tata Cliq Lux (<a href="https://luxury.tatacliq.com/">luxury.tatacliq.com</a>)</strong> through its authorized seller, Westbury</li>
                                <li>Nykaa (<a href="https://www.nykaa.com/">www.nykaa.com</a> | <a href="https://www.nykaafashion.com/">www.nykaafashion.com</a> | <a href="https://www.nykaaman.com/">www.nykaaman.com</a>), through its authorized seller, Westbury</li>
                            </ul>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                    <h4 class="title-xsmall">Warranty Period</h4>
                    <p>
                        Six months from the date of purchase of the product shall be treated as a valid period to claim warranty for a product purchased in India.
                    </p>

                        We can be reached toll-free for product claim questions at 000 800 040 5043.
                    </p>

\u003ch2 class=\"title-medium\"\u003eCONSUMER CARE STORE CLAIM AND EXCHANGE POLICY\u003c/h2\u003e\n                \u003carticle class=\"nike-claim\"\u003e\n                    \u003ch3 class=\"title-small\"\u003eCLAIMS\u003c/h3\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        If you think your product has a manufacturing defect, you can\n                        \u003ca href=\"https://www.nike.com/in/help/claims/terms\" target=\"_blank\"\u003esubmit a product claim\u003c/a\u003e for purchases made at Nike stores and\n                        authorised Nike retail stores with the following photographs:\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003cul\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eA picture of your product and the area you believe to have a manufacturing defect.\u003c/li\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eThe store receipt or invoice clearly showing the purchase date, purchase location, and purchase amount.\u003c/li\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eThe product tag on your footwear or apparel (please ensure the product number is clearly visible). For equipment claims, be sure to include a picture of the attached sticker.\n                        \u003c/li\u003e\n                    \u003c/ul\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        After a claim is submitted, Nike will then inspect the claim to determine if the condition of the claim product is due to a manufacturing defect or not. Nike’s decision in respect of the claim product shall be final and confidential. If Nike is unable to process the claim on the basis of the information or photographs sent, the same will be communicated to the store and consumer through the same claim thread.\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        Upon receipt of the authorisation email from Nike for replacement of a product, the consumer should present a hard or soft copy of the email to the original place of purchase. The authorised partner will then allow the consumer to choose a product of the same or lesser purchase value of the original purchase as available at that time in the store.\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        In case of unavailability of the same or similar product there shall be no cash refund, but the consumer will be entitled to choose any other Nike product from the available stock that's equal to or lower than the actual price paid. If the replacement value is lower, the differential amount shall not be refunded. If the replacement value is higher than the purchase value, the consumer shall have to pay the differential of the amount.\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        Stores, retailers, and consumers must ensure that the replacement process is completed within 30 calendar days from the date of the authorisation email sent by Nike. After 30 calendar days, the consumer will not be eligible for a replacement from Nike.\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                \u003c/article\u003e\n                \u003carticle class=\"claim-elegibility\"\u003e\n                    \u003ch3 class=\"title-small\"\u003eCLAIM ELIGIBILITY\u003c/h3\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        Claims past six months from the original purchase date will not be accepted. Claims will also be rejected in the following situations:\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003cul\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eAny counterfeit or non-genuine Nike products.\u003c/li\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eAny product missing its manufacturing tag or product sticker.\u003c/li\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eAny item deemed to be free of a manufacturing defect or flaw.\u003c/li\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eAny products that exhibit excessive wear, misuse, alteration, or wear and tear deemed to be normal.\u003c/li\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eAny products subjected to harsh treatment, such as contact with any sharp, rough, abrasive, or acidic materials that may cause damage, intentional or not.\u003c/li\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eAny product deemed by Nike to have been damaged by misuse.\u003c/li\u003e\n                        \u003cli\u003eAny product purchased from online or store retailers that are not authorised by Nike.\u003c/li\u003e\n                    \u003c/ul\u003e\n                \u003c/article\u003e\n                \u003carticle class=\"exchange-elegibility\"\u003e\n                    \u003ch3 class=\"title-small\"\u003eEXCHANGE ELIGIBILITY\u003c/h3\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        Products can only be exchanged due to size, fit, or style at the original place of purchase. Nike-authorised retail partners have their own respective return and exchange policies, hence please refer to your invoice or the store’s terms and conditions.\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                \u003c/article\u003e\n                \u003carticle class=\"definitions-elegibility\"\u003e\n                    \u003ch3 class=\"title-small\"\u003eDEFINITIONS AND ELIGIBILITY\u003c/h3\u003e\n                    \u003ch4 class=\"title-xsmall\"\u003eBusiness Days\u003c/h4\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003eBusiness days shall mean English calendar days.\u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003ch4 class=\"title-xsmall\"\u003eConsumer\u003c/h4\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        A consumer shall mean and include any person, or individual, who has purchased a product from any Nike store or Nike-authorised retail partner.\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003ch4 class=\"title-xsmall\"\u003eClaim Procedure\u003c/h4\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        The procedure, as outlined herein, to be followed by the consumer to claim a replacement of a Nike product.\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003ch4 class=\"title-xsmall\"\u003eDiscount\u003c/h4\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        Sale of products at a discount which shall be offered to a consumer at a Nike factory store or Nike authorised store, physical and online.\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003ch4 class=\"title-xsmall\"\u003eManufacturing Defects\u003c/h4\u003e\n                    \u003cp\u003e\n                        Any and all defects in production pertaining to materials or workmanship. Such defects include issues related to bonding, stitching, material or components failure, cosmetics, and workmanship. This guarantee applies when the product is used under normal conditions and for the purpose for which the product was designed. This does not apply to normal wear and tear or damage related to alteration, accident, misuse, improper care, or negligence.\n                    \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003ch4 14 years) Younger Kids (4 - 7 years) Babies & Toddlers (0 - 4 years) Shop By Sports Running Gym & Training Accessories & Equipment All Accessories & Equipment Bags & Backpacks Hats & Headwear New & Featured New Arrivals Bestsellers Men Shop All New Arrivals Clothing Shoes Bag & Accessories Women Shop All New Arrivals Clothing Shoes Bag & Accessories Kids Shop All Shoes Sport Jordan Basketball Jordan Football Enjoy 15% Off On The Nike App. Use: APP15 Download Now T&Cs CONSUMER CARE STORE CLAIM AND EXCHANGE POLICY CLAIMS If you think your product has a manufacturing defect, you can submit a product claim for purchases made at Nike stores and authorised Nike retail stores with the following photographs: A picture of your product and the area you believe to have a manufacturing defect. The store receipt or invoice clearly showing the purchase date, purchase location, and purchase amount. The product tag on your footwear or apparel (please ensure the product number is clearly visible). For equipment claims, be sure to include a picture of the attached sticker. After a claim is submitted, Nike will then inspect the claim to determine if the condition of the claim product is due to a manufacturing defect or not. Nike’s decision in respect of the claim product shall be final and confidential. If Nike is unable to process the claim on the basis of the information or photographs sent, the same will be communicated to the store and consumer through the same claim thread. Upon receipt of the authorisation email from Nike for replacement of a product, the consumer should present a hard or soft copy of the email to the original place of purchase. The authorised partner will then allow the consumer to choose a product of the same or lesser purchase value of the original purchase as available at that time in the store. In case of unavailability of the same or similar product there shall be no cash refund, but the consumer will be entitled to choose any other Nike product from the available stock that's equal to or lower than the actual price paid. If the replacement value is lower, the differential amount shall not be refunded. If the replacement value is higher than the purchase value, the consumer shall have to pay the differential of the amount. Stores, retailers, and consumers must ensure that the replacement process is completed within 30 calendar days from the date of the authorisation email sent by Nike. After 30 calendar days, the consumer will not be eligible for a replacement from Nike. CLAIM ELIGIBILITY Claims past six months from the original purchase date will not be accepted. Claims will also be rejected in the following situations: Any counterfeit or non-genuine Nike products. Any product missing its manufacturing tag or product sticker. Any item deemed to be free of a manufacturing defect or flaw. Any products that exhibit excessive wear, misuse, alteration, or wear and tear deemed to be normal. Any products subjected to harsh treatment, such as contact with any sharp, rough, abrasive, or acidic materials that may cause damage, intentional or not. Any product deemed by Nike to have been damaged by misuse. Any product purchased from online or store retailers that are not authorised by Nike. EXCHANGE ELIGIBILITY Products can only be exchanged due to size, fit, or style at the original place of purchase. Nike-authorised retail partners have their own respective return and exchange policies, hence please refer to your invoice or the store’s terms and conditions. DEFINITIONS AND ELIGIBILITY Business Days Business days shall mean English calendar days. Consumer A consumer shall mean and include any person, or individual, who has purchased a product from any Nike store or Nike-authorised retail partner. Claim Procedure The procedure, as outlined herein, to be followed by the consumer to claim a replacement of a Nike product. Discount Sale of products at a discount which shall be offered to a consumer at a Nike factory store or Nike authorised store, physical and online. Manufacturing Defects Any and all defects in production pertaining to materials or workmanship. Such defects include issues related to bonding, stitching, material or components failure, cosmetics, and workmanship. This guarantee applies when the product is used under normal conditions and for the purpose for which the product was designed. This does not apply to normal wear and tear or damage related to alteration, accident, misuse, improper care, or negligence. Maximum Retail Price (MRP), Normal Conditions MRP shall mean the maximum retail price at which a Nike product is sold which shall not include the discount offered, if any, on the products. Products The Nike products shall be broadly categorized into footwear, apparel, equipment, and any other category which shall stand included into the existing categories by Nike upon introduction of such line of products in the Indian retail market. Store Stores authorised by Nike can be classified into the following three categories listed below in this policy, which shall include the mono-brand store, multi-brand store, and the factory outlet store. Mono-brand Store Stores exclusively selling Nike-branded products are referred to as the mono-brand stores, and the business shall be conducted by different retail partners across the country appointed by Nike as authorised partners. Multi-brand Store The stores that cater to multiple brands and shall also be selling Nike products within their stores alongside other branded products. Footlocker Veg Non Veg Superkicks Limited Edt Kick Sports Metro Activ Shoppers Stop Sports Yard V-Retail Online store purchase Online store purchase shall mean and include a purchase made by a consumer from Nike or Nike authorised online retailer in India that sells Nike product. Authorised online retailers include: Ajio ( http://www.ajio.com ) Flipkart ( http://www.flipkart.com ) Myntra ( http://www.myntra.com ) VegNonVeg ( https://www.vegnonveg.com ) Superkicks ( https://www.superkicks.in ) NBA Store ( https://www.nbastore.in ) Amazon ( www.amazon.in ), through its authorized seller, Westbury Tata Cliq ( www.tatacliq.com ) & Tata Cliq Lux ( luxury.tatacliq.com ) through its authorized seller, Westbury Nykaa ( www.nykaa.com | www.nykaafashion.com | www.nykaaman.com ), through its authorized seller, Westbury Warranty Period Six months from the date of purchase of the product shall be treated as a valid period to claim warranty for a product purchased in India.
